title: Codex delegation without a model argument defaults to a model the host's Codex account rejects (gpt-5.4 on WinB), and the failed spawn leaves its isolated worktree behind
outcome: A Codex delegation spawned without a model argument uses a model the host's Codex account supports, or is refused at spawn with the supported model names before any worktree is created; and a spawn whose child fails at once leaves no orphaned isolated worktree, or records it for cleanup.
acceptance: Codex delegation without a model argument defaults to a model the host's Codex account rejects (gpt-5.4 on WinB), and the failed spawn leaves its isolated worktree behind is done
